parameter_source_contract.rule: Every runtime parameter must declare current source tier and upgrade rule before being treated as production-ready.

kd_length.source_basis: The current KD length is frozen as the v1 project contract default for the first multi-timeframe KD diagnostic contract.
kd_length.evidence_anchor: 技术指标_随机指标_多周期KD共振_P0_最小实施草案_v1.md
kd_length.upgrade_rule: Keep 13 as the v1 KD length unless a later audited source binding requires a different core definition and triggers a new version.

kd_smooth_k.source_basis: The current K smoothing value is frozen as the v1 project contract default to keep the first runtime contract stable.
kd_smooth_k.evidence_anchor: 技术指标_随机指标_多周期KD共振_P0_最小实施草案_v1.md
kd_smooth_k.upgrade_rule: Keep 3 as the v1 K smoothing value unless a later audited source binding requires a different setting and triggers a new version.

kd_smooth_d.source_basis: The current D smoothing value is frozen as the v1 project contract default to keep the first runtime contract stable.
kd_smooth_d.evidence_anchor: 技术指标_随机指标_多周期KD共振_P0_最小实施草案_v1.md
kd_smooth_d.upgrade_rule: Keep 3 as the v1 D smoothing value unless a later audited source binding requires a different setting and triggers a new version.

ma_type.source_basis: The first runtime contract keeps SMA as the explicit averaging mode to avoid hidden implementation drift.
ma_type.evidence_anchor: 技术指标_随机指标_多周期KD共振_后续对象定义入口_v1.md
ma_type.upgrade_rule: Keep SMA in v1 unless a later audited implementation binding requires another averaging mode.

price_field.source_basis: The first runtime contract uses close-based mapping only and does not expand into alternative price-field variants.
price_field.evidence_anchor: 技术指标_随机指标_多周期KD共振_后续对象定义入口_v1.md
price_field.upgrade_rule: Keep close_close in v1 unless a later audited source binding requires another input field family.

week_extreme_low.source_basis: The weekly oversold threshold is currently frozen as a conservative project contract default for v1 proof work.
week_extreme_low.upgrade_rule: Keep 20 in v1 until stronger audited source evidence is available; upgrade by opening a new version instead of silently editing v1.

week_extreme_high.source_basis: The weekly overbought threshold is currently frozen as a conservative project contract default for v1 proof work.
week_extreme_high.upgrade_rule: Keep 80 in v1 until stronger audited source evidence is available; upgrade by opening a new version instead of silently editing v1.

h4_confirm_tie_epsilon.source_basis: The v1 contract defaults to exact equality for h4_confirm tie detection; widen only with explicit evidence and record the chosen epsilon.
h4_confirm_tie_epsilon.upgrade_rule: If a non-zero epsilon becomes the default, keep it frozen in v1 and open a new version if the tie policy changes again.
